answer.summary: The E2E job failed because the application never became ready. The API did not return 200 on /api/me within 300s, and Spring Boot logged an ERROR failure report right after the last Flyway migration (V6 Add_tenant_id_to_execution_traces). The excerpt is truncated and does not show the root cause. A startup failure right after a migration is more likely to repeat than to be flaky, so I lean no_retry, but the log does not confirm it. The touched file is only a unit test, so check whether the branch's migrations or config are the cause.
